source.name: Zimbabwe Rugby Union: Sables Name Match-Day 23 for Nations Cup Opener Against Tonga (official match-day squad announcement)
source.quote: Zimbabwe Sables head coach Pieter Benade has named his match-day 23 for the opening fixture of the Nations Cup against the TONGA at Dicks Sporting Goods Park, Denver, Colorado
source.note: The official match-day-23 graphic on this page (Copy-of-starting-xi.png, opened and read on 2026-10-04) shows the current home shirt: green-and-white hoops, Reebok wordmark on the right chest, the Zimbabwe Rugby Union star crest on the left chest, and the large Nedbank 'N' crest on the chest with NEDBANK lettering across the front. A strip under the squad list shows the campaign partners: CFAO Mobility, Intrachem, Dallaglio, Sable Lager, Nedbank, Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc, Alliance Health and Nyaradzo Group. Nedbank also appears across the front of the match shirt in the USA v Zimbabwe Nations Cup photo published by Fanzone (14 July 2026, https://fanzone.co.zw/sables-turn-attention-to-canada-after-battling-usa-in-nations-cup/).

source.quote: Zimbabwe Sables head coach Pieter Benade has named his match-day 23 for the opening fixture of the Nations Cup against the TONGA at Dicks Sporting Goods Park, Denver, Colorado
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The Reebok wordmark and Vector logo sit on the right chest of the home shirt, and on the match shorts, in the official match-day graphic on this page. Zimbabwe Rugby announced Reebok as its technical kit partner on 25 June 2026 (Kyros Sports, https://x.com/kyrossports/status/2070192199623377180 and https://www.instagram.com/p/DaBEHrjpZwd/, both opened 2026-10-04; social-media pages can't be quote-checked by a script, and the replica was reported to go on sale from August 2026). The previous 2025/26 home replica was by Umbro South Africa (umbro.co.za/collections/zimbabwe-rugby, opened 2026-10-04).

summary: Nedbank, the Zimbabwean bank of JSE-listed Nedbank Group, across the front of the green-and-white hooped Reebok home shirt first worn at the World Rugby Nations Cup 2026 in July (kit unveiled 25-26 June 2026). The official match-day graphic shows no other commercial mark on the chest, but a sleeve sponsor (dark lettering, ending '...AMELO' on one sleeve and 'Ol...' on the other) cannot be reliably identified from the available images, and no image of the back of the shirt has been found, so the sponsor list is not yet complete.
